selection: both cohorts; seed 1 of all 15 tasks; last published snapshot; 3 equally-spaced saved configurations during that snapshot interval
proxy_budget: same full measured-cell count and centers; no removal, merging or hand-selected cap
unknown_space: excluded from index/component timing; unchanged exact boxes retained in separate full-map clearance comparison
coverage: analytic inclusion of saved directional uncertainty sets and scalar offsets; does not independently re-prove sensor noise bound or raw-world coverage
qp_scope: one-step frozen-pose observed-obstacle LiuQP workload; no planner, no integration, no perception, no frontier rows or execution guard; same zero previous velocity and final target
threading: one pinned CPU, one native geometry thread, BLAS=1
fusion: native fused shortcut hidden in all three query arms to isolate index/SIMD; no frozen runtime changes
timing: warmup then deterministic randomized interleaving; build cost separate; descriptive median/p95, not hard real-time guarantee
